name: The art of doing a truely bad kami
source:
Once upon a sleepless night, Toni decided to show you how bad Kamis are made. But not just ordinary bad kamis. I'm talking about stories this bad that they can only have been done like this on purpose...

[From [url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/badkami.html]Otaku World[/url]]
translation:
曾经有一个不眠之夜，托尼决定向你展示卡米斯的制作有多糟糕。但不仅仅是普通的坏卡米斯。我说的是那些如此糟糕的故事，它们只能是故意这样做的……

[来自[url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/badkami.html]宅男世界[/url]]
